intendedPolicy.rulesetName: Protect main — require PR + CI + approval-gate
intendedPolicy.approvalAuthority: approval-gate workflow (owner approval plus exact-head promotion evidence on the still-open PR)
intendedPolicy.headRevocation: Any head movement revokes promotion evidence until re-verified
intendedPolicy.integrationStrategy: Verify and review the immutable PR head; for proven-disjoint tranches, merge that head into current main with a merge commit without requiring latest-main ancestry. Head movement still revokes exact-head evidence.
